content: मित {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} [मि मा-वा-क्त] .²1 Measured, meted or measured out. .²2 Measured off, bounded, defined. .²3 Limited, measured, moderate, little, scanty, sparing, brief (words <ab>&c.</ab>); पृष्टः सत्यं मितं ब्रूते स भृत्योऽर्हो महीभुजाम् <ls>Pt. 1. 87</ls>; <ls>R. 9. 34</ls>. .²4 Measuring, of the measure of (at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>), as in ग्रहवसुकरिचन्द्रमिते वर्षे {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} in 1889. .²5 Investigated, examined. .²6 Cast, thrown away. .²7 Built. .²8 Established, founded.
